mapper.select: SELECT f.id, f.name, f.group_id AS groupId, f.in_port AS inPort, f.remote_addr AS remoteAddr, f.status, f.created_time AS createdTime, f.updated_time AS updatedTime, f.target_strategy AS targetStrategy, f.speed_id AS speedId, f.interface_name AS interfaceName, f.in_flow AS inFlow, f.out_flow AS outFlow, f.inx AS inx, g.name AS groupName, g.strategy AS groupStrategy, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM group_link gl WHERE gl.group_id = g.id AND gl.status = 1) AS linkCount, (SELECT n.id FROM link l JOIN group_link gl2 ON gl2.link_id = l.id AND gl2.status = 1 JOIN node n ON n.id = l.entry_node_id WHERE gl2.group_id = g.id AND l.status = 1 LIMIT 1) AS entryNodeId, (SELECT n.name FROM link l JOIN group_link gl2 ON gl2.link_id = l.id AND gl2.status = 1 JOIN node n ON n.id = l.entry_node_id WHERE gl2.group_id = g.id AND l.status = 1 LIMIT 1) AS entryNodeName, (SELECT n.status FROM link l JOIN group_link gl2 ON gl2.link_id = l.id AND gl2.status = 1 JOIN node n ON n.id = l.entry_node_id WHERE gl2.group_id = g.id AND l.status = 1 LIMIT 1) AS entryNodeStatus, sl.name AS speedName FROM forward f LEFT JOIN lb_group g ON f.group_id = g.id LEFT JOIN speed_limit sl ON f.speed_id = sl.id ORDER BY f.created_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM forward WHERE group_id = #{groupId}
